title.zh: Suno 独立音效生成接口 (suno-sounds) 上线

summary.en: Dedicated sound effects generation model `suno-sounds` is now available on OmniMux via POST /v1/video/generations.
summary.zh: 独立音效生成模型 `suno-sounds` 现已接入 OmniMux，支持通过 POST /v1/video/generations 端点生成场景音效。

body.en:
## Suno Sound Effects

The dedicated sound effect generation model `suno-sounds` is now supported on OmniMux.

### Model specification

- **Model ID:** `suno-sounds`
- **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/video/generations`
- **Polling endpoint:** `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`
- **Authentication:** Bearer token (`sk-...`)
- **Modality:** Ambient and scene sound effects without vocal lyrics

### Request example

```bash
curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.omnimux.ai/v1/video/generations \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer sk-...' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "model": "suno-sounds",
    "prompt": "footsteps on gravel followed by heavy rain and distant thunder"
  }'
```

Details are available in the [Suno API Reference](/en/api-reference/audio-series/models/suno).
body.zh:
## Suno 音效生成

独立场景音效生成模型 `suno-sounds` 现已在 OmniMux 提供异步调用支持。

### 接口规范

- **模型标识：** `suno-sounds`
- **创建端点：** `POST /v1/video/generations`
- **任务轮询端点：** `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`
- **鉴权方式：** Bearer 令牌鉴权（`sk-...`）
- **生成模态：** 纯场景音效与环境音（无声乐伴奏与人声歌词）

### 请求示例

```bash
curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.omnimux.ai/v1/video/generations \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer sk-...' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "model": "suno-sounds",
    "prompt": "碎石路上的脚步声，伴随暴雨和远处的雷声"
  }'
```

完整参数定义与状态说明请参阅 [Suno 接口参考文档](/zh/api-reference/audio-series/models/suno)。
